neighbours.label: Best guess: the modifier that names one kind in a list of kinds of the same thing ("There is income tax, property tax, ..."; alcohol-based, optical zoom); weak and inconsistent in probes
fire: Drivers face several kinds of insurance. There is liability insurance, collision insurance and travel insurance.
Farmers here deal with many types of soil. There is clay soil, sandy soil and chalk soil.
Students can apply for different sorts of aid. There is merit aid, family aid and emergency aid.
Every shop pays a range of taxes. There is sales tax, income tax and excise tax.
Hospitals treat several kinds of pain. There is nerve pain, muscle pain and joint pain.
The store sells many types of paint. There is oil paint, latex paint and chalk paint.
Banks offer various kinds of loans. There is student debt, mortgage debt and card debt.
Cameras offer two sorts of zoom. There is optical zoom, digital zoom and hybrid zoom.
quiet: Drivers face several costs each year. There is a lot to pay, and many of them grumble.
Farmers here work long days. There is much to do before the rain arrives in autumn.
Students can apply in the spring. There is a long form, and it takes an hour to finish.
Every shop opens early on Fridays. There is a queue outside before the doors are unlocked.
Hospitals are busy in winter. There is rarely an empty bed, and the staff are tired.
The store closes at six. There is a car park behind it and a bus stop in front.
Banks are quiet on Mondays. There is seldom a queue, and the clerks have time to chat.
Cameras were cheaper last year. There is less choice now, and prices keep rising.

notes: Probes: 'There is property tax, sales tax and payroll tax' 0.38; 'pay income tax' 0.06, 'alcohol-based hand rub' 0.14, 'food allergy' 0.02, 'digital zoom' 0.10. The list-of-kinds frame is the only thing that reached 0.3, from one sentence; expect a fail.
